Here’s how to properly complete the IA 2848 (Iowa POA) if you only have a PTIN and CAF:
*Section 1 – Taxpayer Info*
 Complete normally (name, address, SSN or FEIN, contact info).
*Section 2 – Representative*
 Under “Representative identification number” you can enter:
 • Your PTIN *or*
 • Your CAF
Then check the matching box (PTIN or CAF).
You do NOT need an Iowa Account Number (IAN). PTIN and CAF are acceptable per the form instructions.
Best practice: use your CAF if you have one.
Complete the rest with your IRS-registered name, mailing address, phone, and email.
*Tax types / matters*
 List specific types (Individual Income, Withholding, Sales & Use, Corporate, Collections, etc.)
 If left blank, it defaults to all matters.
*Tax periods*
 If left blank, it defaults to all periods from account start through 3 years forward.
 Limit it if you want tighter scope.
*Exclusions*
 Leave blank unless intentionally restricting authority.
*Section 3 – Refund checks*
 Usually leave blank unless client wants you to receive (not endorse) refund checks.
*Section 4 – Authorized Rep Info*
 Only complete if someone other than the taxpayer is signing.
 If taxpayer signs, skip this section.
*Section 5 – Signature*
 Must be hand-signed or digital certificate.
 Typed or stamped signatures are rejected.
 If joint return, each spouse needs their own IA 2848.
*Important:*
 PTIN/CAF allows administrative representation.
 Formal contested case hearings may require EA/CPA/Attorney under Iowa rules.
Submit within 6 months of signature or it will be rejected.
 Submit via GovConnectIowa (preferred), mail, or fax. Do not email.

Canopy has updated their interface.  They've introduced the concept of `Contacts`.
*What are Contacts in Canopy?*

A `Client` can be a business or an individual.  Regardless, there's still _someone_ you're going to contact regarding the deal or work to be performed.  The `Contact` list, is a list of individual human people, who can be assigned to a client.
This means a single contact can be for both Dave's Doggy Diapers, as well as Dave F's taxes.  I'm Dave :wave: ... the contact.

Contacts can be 1:many in Canopy.
